newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up with cargo, buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up with cargo, buyers sidelined.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted higher from Thursday's quotes, in expectation of continued firmer cargo prices prices, traders said.

Some majors were unwilling to lower offers, anticipating higher cargo prices. Major quoted 180-cst at $126 per tonne and 380-cst at $122. Independents were at $124 for 180-cst and $120 for 380-cst. Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $120-$122 and 380-cst at $115-$119 on Thursday. Enquiries were thin as some buyers were sidelined due to the high offers, traders said.
MDO was quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil at $220--$225. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
